about: THE PLATINUM RUN — an offline GTA VI trophy guide and tracker. Trophy names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation 5 list. Earn rates are live player data read from Exophase on 20 Nov 2026. Every guide is written for this app and cites its sources by number.

stages.title: Opening & Chapter 1
stages.note: Start the story and finish Chapter 1. Scan every new vehicle with the WAiNK app as you go — the habit pays off on two counters later [1]. POINT OF NO RETURN: before Chapter 1 ends, take Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house; it never comes back [1][4]. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter — there is no mission replay [1].

stages.title: Chapter 2 — Both Characters
stages.note: The mission Coffee Break unlocks free-roam with Jason and Lucia together, which opens the partner trophies [1]. Buy garages early so registered vehicles have somewhere to live [1].

stages.title: Chapter 3 — Vice City Opens Up
stages.note: Andy's strand is Lucia-only and Tyrone's is Jason-only, so switch to the right character before you travel [1]. This chapter hands you the Key Cloner and the Dye Pack Jammer and unlocks jewelry robberies [1].

stages.title: Chapter 4 — The Big Scores
stages.note: The optional café mission That's Where The Money Is… unlocks the large bank vaults — the best money in the game, and it feeds three trophies at once [1].

stages.title: Chapter 5 & The Finale
stages.note: Finish the story. Free-roam continues afterwards, and nothing the 100% checklist needs can be missed [1].

stages.title: Free-Roam — The 100% Grind
stages.note: Work the checklist at Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. It is closer to 60% of the game: 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 70 of 80 challenges, and only some collectibles in full [1][5].

stages.title: The Platinum
stages.note: When the other 54 trophies are earned, the platinum is awarded on its own — no online play and no DLC needed [1][2].

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.summary: The platinum itself: it is awarded the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, with no online play and no DLC involved.

steps.text: Earn every other trophy in the single-player list; the platinum then pops on its own.
Follow the roadmap order so the long 100% grind overlaps the story instead of sitting at the end.
One playthrough is enough: there are no difficulty settings and no mission replay to worry about.
Keep cheats off for the whole run: using one disables trophies and saving.

steps.text: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, through to the end — it is the game's introduction.
The trophy unlocks automatically as the mission completes; nothing optional is involved.

The award lands as Chapter 2 opens, at the start of its first main mission, What's in the Bag?
During this chapter, take Lucia's balcony meditation when she offers it — it is gone for good once the chapter ends.

Keep a manual save before the finale — with no mission replay, a save is the only way back.
After the credits you keep free-roaming, and everything for 100% completion stays available.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.summary: The long gold. The 100% checklist is far kinder than it sounds — it asks for roughly 60% of everything in the game — but it is still the biggest time sink on the list.

steps.text: Finish the story first: the checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Progress you made during the story already counts towards it.
Complete in full the categories that demand everything: all robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests.
Hit the partial targets elsewhere: scan 200 of 277 base-model vehicles and study 100 of 255 animals.
Finish 70 of the 80 challenges and any 100 optional missions.
Nothing on the checklist can be missed — everything stays available in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.summary: Any 250 of the game's 397 stunts, mixed across four families — you never need the hardest ones.

steps.text: Pick from four stunt families: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps.
Under-the-bridge flights are the quickest to bank in bulk.
Mix categories freely to reach 250.
Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or by name on the map's Exploration layer.
Note the 100% checklist separately asks for 300 stunts, so this trophy pops on the way there.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.summary: A sampler trophy: one go at each of the game's nine activity types. Most players earn it without trying.

steps.text: The tracker counts 9 activity types: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race or drone race, and performing a stunt.
Check what you have touched under Touchpad > Progress > Activities — scrolling a type shows your count for it.
The story and the 100% grind introduce nearly all of them automatically; mop up any gap from the map's Activities filter.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.summary: Gold in every Shooting Range challenge — 42 golds spread across the ranges. The ranges also have to be completed in full for the 100% checklist.

steps.text: There are 42 Shooting Range challenges across the game's range locations; each one needs a gold-medal score.
Work range by range and retry freely — attempts cost nothing and the golds are described as not too difficult.
Range practice also raises your Focus stat, which makes the Gunslinger trophy easier later.
Find the ranges on the map under Touch Pad > Activities > Shooting Ranges.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.summary: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. Drone races are also a complete-everything category on the 100% checklist.

steps.text: There are 14 Top Fun locations holding 42 drone races in total; one win at each location is what the trophy asks.
Clear a location fully while you are there — the 100% checklist wants the drone races done anyway.
Some locations charge an entry fee; find every spot under Touch Pad > Activities > Drones > Top Fun Drones.

steps.text: There are 40 unique race locations; win 20 different ones for the trophy.
Bring a fast car of your own once garages and registrations open up.
Work through the map region by region.
Keep track of race locations under Touch Pad > Activities > Racing.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.summary: Beat your friend Cal at his own fishing challenge. It is the most-earned optional trophy in the game right now — a quick, friendly win.

steps.text: Meet Cal first, in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui; some time afterwards he texts you a fishing spot, marked with a purple icon west of Key Lento.
His request is a Parrotfish over 2 kg: fish the marked area until you land one that size.
You need a boat with a fishing rod; if you don't own one, there are plenty in the area to take.
Go to the marked spot and win his fishing challenge to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.summary: Finish one of the game's four arcade video games, end to end. Three of them sit on the TV at home from Chapter 1.

steps.text: Three of the 4 arcade games — Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind — are on the TV at home.
The fourth, Bang For Your Buck, is on arcade machines around the world.
Completing a game means finishing all of its levels once — its extra challenges are not required.
The home TV games are playable from Chapter 1, though some story sections pause access until after the story.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.summary: Finish Andy's five-quest strand. It is Lucia's storyline only, it starts in Chapter 3, and it waits for you after the story if you leave it.

steps.text: The strand marks itself in Chapter 3: playing as Lucia, Andy calls, then texts her home address in Belville.
Work her five quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! (the Cellerica initiation), Read the Label (retrieve the van) and Puff Puff Pass (the warehouse meet).
Andy's quests stay available after the story, so the trophy cannot be missed.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.summary: Finish Kenton Rees's treasure-diving strand: seven shipwrecks' worth of underwater loot, starting in Chapter 1. He goes quiet mid-story but always comes back.

steps.text: The strand starts in Chapter 1 after the mission Island Dreams: Kenton calls and appears as the green KR icon in Key Lento.
Dive his marked shipwrecks — purple treasure-chest icons — and use the metal detector to dig the treasure out of the ocean floor.
Bring the treasure back to him.
He wants 7 shipwrecks cleared in total; progress shows under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees and Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures.
Kenton becomes unavailable for a stretch after Chapter 1 and returns in Chapter 2–3 with a text to Jason — he is not missable.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.summary: Eight full stranger strands — but only true strangers count. The named character questlines (Andy, Billy, Tyrone and friends) do not count toward this one.

steps.text: Confirmed counting strands include Kirk's Skunk Ape hunt, Kyle's farm strand, Yago's street-race strand and Pilot Pete's delivery strand.
Questlines for Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count as strangers for this trophy, however long they are.
Strangers stay in the world after the story, and the trophy list itself tracks how many strands you have banked.
Strangers & Freaks are not needed for the 100% checklist, so treat this as its own cleanup pass.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.summary: Fill Randy's Wish List: sixteen named sports cars, stolen and delivered to his garage in the west of Vice City.

steps.text: The strand opens in Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you unlock the Key Cloner and deliver him a Zorrusso as part of the story.
His list holds 16 sports cars; track it under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List.
Scan high-end cars with the WAiNK app to check whether one is wanted.
Listed cars cluster around the hotels of Vice Beach and Ocean Beach; deliver them undamaged and he pays more.
The list can still be finished after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.summary: Finish Tyrone's two-quest strand: shut down the synthetic labs, then take his final job. Jason only — Lucia cannot run it.

steps.text: The strand marks itself after Chapter 3's Here, Kitty Kitty, and only while you play as Jason.
First quest, Take Out Kitty Litter: destroy the Synthetic Labs marked in purple around Vice City.
Destroy enough labs and Tyrone offers his second quest, Spin On This (Shut Down the Labs) — finishing it unlocks the trophy.
The strand stays available after the story.

Browse and track them under Progress > Challenges — a completed one carries a checkmark in the corner.
Leave it late: most challenges complete themselves while you work on everything else, then pick the quickest of what remains.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.summary: Reach four stars with your partner beside you, then break out of the red heat zone. The bank vault robberies hand you this for free later.

steps.text: You need both characters together, so the earliest chance is after Chapter 2's Coffee Break.
Call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle.
Cause enough trouble to reach a 4-star wanted level, then escape: a fast motorcycle through traffic works.
The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County breaks line of sight completely.
The trophy pops when you leave the red heat zone, not the smaller flashing search area.
It also arrives automatically during the large bank vault robberies, which always trigger 4 stars and an escape.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.summary: Three shop robberies in one unbroken police chase, partner in tow. The three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City make a tidy circuit.

steps.text: Start after Coffee Break so your partner can ride with you; call them with Right + Triangle and keep them close.
Go in prepared: body armour, sticky bombs and healing items.
Rob three robbery targets (green map icons) in a row while the red-and-blue flashing wanted level stays alive the whole time.
Loot properly in each store — take items and crack the back-room safe — or a store may not count.
If the trophy has not popped after the third, keep going to a fourth.
The unlock is delayed by about half a minute after the last shop.
The three jewelry stores in north Vice City, open after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, are a reliable circuit.

Stand at a busy road and scan traffic as it passes — new models add up quickly, boats and aircraft included.
Check your tally under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.
The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning past 100.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.summary: Five takedowns inside one few-second Combat Focus. Preparation is everything: a full focus bar, adrenaline, armour and a crowd of criminals.

steps.text: Combat Focus triggers with L3 + R3 while aiming.
Time slows, weak spots light up, and the purple focus bar under your health drains fast.
Beforehand, top up focus with food, drink or a shower at home, and take Adrenaline to stretch the effect.
Wear body armour from an Ammu-Nation.
Line up five criminals at a Gang Operation and drop them with an accurate full-auto rifle such as the Duke 556 — the trophy does not count police, soldiers or civilians.
It gets easier as your Focus level rises (to level 4) through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.summary: Steal a passenger jet that is docked at a VCIA terminal bridge and fly it away. Planes parked on the open airfield do not count.

steps.text: It must be a large passenger plane connected to a boarding bridge — the one at departure terminals E3/E4 is the easiest.
Cut through a fence around the airfield and use the stairs beside the bridge to enter the plane directly, then go up to the cockpit.
Taxi back to the runway, take off and fly about 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport.
The unlock is slightly delayed.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.summary: A silent jewelry job: in through the back door with the Snap Gun, safe emptied, cameras and alarm dealt with, out without a sound.

steps.text: First finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks jewelry robberies and the Snap Gun, which silently picks alarmed doors and stays in your inventory.
Enter a jewelry store through its back door using the Snap Gun prompt (kicking the door trips the alarm and ruins the attempt).
In the back room, find the note with the safe code and loot the safe.
Destroy the security footage and disable the alarm.
Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target; the trophy pops shortly after you leave.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.summary: Five large bank vaults emptied and escaped. There are eight in the game, all eight are needed for 100%, and each pays out serious endgame money.

steps.text: Unlock the system in Chapter 4's optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe).
Tail a security van until a guard carries the cash case into the bank and the vault opens, then get inside while it is open.
You cannot carry it all alone — bring your partner and hand a bag off with Right.
Afterwards, buy security-van tips from Yasmani for $10,000; purple icons mark the vans.
He sells them once his earlier jobs, including 2 Payday Loans, are done.
Every vault robbery is an instant 4-star wanted level: escape on a fast motorcycle, then swap vehicles to go unrecognised.
Any 5 of the 8 large bank jobs earn the trophy; all 8 are required for the 100% checklist, and a vault can pay up to $205,000.

Either way the trophy only lands once you escape the red heat radius (a Pay 'n' Spray works too).
Sticky bombs are sold at the back of Yasmani's shop after his jobs.

count.label: key valuables taken at Kingpin Bowling

No verified unlock method has been published for this trophy yet — the fullest guide we cite lists it as currently unknown [1][5][6][7][10]. 2. The leading belief connects it to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue, in Little Cuba, Vice City — possibly robbing it again later in a specific way [1]. 3. trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.summary: The UFO easter egg: a blinking car on a Kelly County road after 2 AM, a path into the woods, and a close encounter. Go alone, and be patient — the spawn is random.

steps.text: Head solo, at night after 2 AM, to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County.
Look for a blinking car at the roadside; if it is not there, drive away and come back — the spawn is not guaranteed.
From the car, follow the path into the woods toward the bright blue light and approach the UFO.
It drops a woman it abducted: talk to her, offer help, and walk her back to her car at the roadside to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.summary: From a moving bike, kick ten pedestrians inside sixty seconds. Crowded pavements are the whole trick.

steps.text: Ride any motorcycle and kick pedestrians with Square as you pass them — ten kicks inside 60 seconds is the target.
Work crowded areas such as central Vice City or Ocean Beach so the next target is always a few metres away.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.summary: Hand a quarter of a million dollars of marked bills to your fences, in total, across as many robberies as it takes. Yasmani pays the best rate.

steps.text: Unlock laundering in Chapter 3's Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), which gives you the Dye Pack Jammer for marked bills.
Rob banks and Payday Loans, then deliver the marked bills to a fence.
Yasmani in Vice City pays the most.
The $250,000 is cumulative across all robberies, and the Chapter 4 bank vaults (up to $205,000 a run) finish it quickly.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.summary: Spend $100,000 in total across every kind of shop. Guns, car mods and tattoos burn money fastest.

steps.text: All spending in all shops counts toward the same $100,000 total — there is no per-shop requirement.
The fastest sinks are guns at the 24 Ammu-Nations, mods at the 14 mod shops and tattoos at the 11 studios.
Clothing (67 stores) and the 19 Pay 'n' Sprays add up too.
Bank-vault money from Chapter 4 onwards makes this trivial — spend as you upgrade rather than saving it for its own sake.
Find shops on the map under Touch Pad > Style.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.summary: Buy all eight purchasable garages — $160,000 all-in — through the real-estate app on your phone. The four story garages do not count.

steps.text: Garages go on sale after Chapter 2's Daily Driver, when the Vice City Real Estate app is installed on your phone.
Buy them through the app.
There are 8 purchasable garages costing $160,000 in total; 4 further garages arrive from the story and are not part of this trophy.
Robberies are the quick way to fund them, especially the bigger scores that unlock in Chapters 3–4.
Garage space is also what lets you register more vehicles for On the Spot, so buy early.
The eight listed garages run from Mitchel Auto Center at $4,000 up to Atlantic Court Garage at $40,000.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.summary: Register ten stolen vehicles to the Scooter Bros app so they can be delivered to you anywhere. Cheap cars and bikes keep the fees down.

steps.text: The Scooter Bros app is installed after Chapter 2's Moses mission, and Moses in Port Gellhorn is where vehicles get registered.
Drive a stolen vehicle to his garage and choose Respray, then Register.
Each registration needs garage space, so Little Boxes comes first.
At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3, cars with standard trackers can be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray instead.
Registration costs money per vehicle — register cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep the bill down.
